spots.line: A hall built for a hundred, holding eleven.
Banners of houses that no longer answer when called.

chests.line: The muster chest, and nobody left to muster.

people.name: a watchman warming through
chatter: Off the wall, into the hall, back onto the wall. That is the year.
The castellan counts nine of us. He counts generously.

people.name: Corvel's second
chatter: The long table is laid for forty. It has been for some time.
Touch nothing on the wall. The names are all we have left up there.

hello: Stand where I can see you. Old habit.
again: Back again. You have more nerve than most of this valley.
Come. Tell me how the roads are.

ask.a: I was the Heart Empire's general for thirty campaigns. I am now its traitor. The armour did not change, only the ballads.
My soldiers would have fought for me. The capital would have burned. I took two who would not stay behind and walked out through the portcullis.
Centurion Silver and Decurion Copper. They have never once asked me where we are going.

bye: Remember that a crown is only a heavier helmet.

people.name: Centurion Silver
chatter: The general does not need to raise his voice. We do it for him.
Thirty campaigns. Not one banner lost.

people.name: Decurion Copper
chatter: Silver's in charge of shouting. I'm in charge of watching.
